summary.text: Son of Priam, Dardanus' line, whom Tydeus' son Diomedes thrust from his car with his brother Chromius — listed among Priam's sons in Apollodorus and distinct from other Homeric namesakes.

story.text: Diomedes took two sons of Priam, Dardanus' son, Echemmon and Chromius, the twain being in one car; even as a lion leapeth among the kine, so he thrust both from their car sorely against their will.
